sn35.149:1.3: katamā ca sā bhikkhave, nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā:
sn35.149:1.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhuṃ anattāti passati, rūpā anattāti passati, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattāti passati, cakkhusamphasso anattāti passati, yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattāti passati. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe… jivhā anattāti passati, rasā anattāti passati, jivhāviññāṇaṃ anattāti passati, jivhāsamphasso anattāti passati, yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattāti passati. kāyo …pe…
sn35.149:1.5: mano anattāti passati, dhammā anattāti passati, manoviññāṇaṃ anattāti passati, manosamphasso anattāti passati, yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattāti passati.
sn35.149:1.6: ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave nibbānasappāyā paṭipadāti.
